origin.description: Stores the tuning settings. The default sample is cross validation with 10 folds.
origin.usage: tune.control(random = FALSE, sampling = c("cross", "fix", "bootstrap"), cross = 10, fix = 2/3)

arguments.name: fix
arguments.text: Training share for a fixed split.

origin.details: sampling is cross, fix, or bootstrap. A unique prefix is accepted.
